newsitem.title: UK: S&P says may upgrade Demachy Worms.
newsitem.headline: S&P says may upgrade Demachy Worms.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it placed its ratings of Demachy Worms & Cie and its related entities on CreditWatch with positive implications.
Demachy Worms & Cie is a small investment bank owned by the Worms Group, a family-controlled French financial and industrial group, S&P said in a statement.
"This action reflects the announcement that ABN-AMRO Bank N.V. signed an agreement to purchase a majority controlling stake in Demachy Worms & Cie in 1997," S&P said.

ABN-AMRO already owns two French banks, Banque Neuflize, Schlumberger, Mallet and Banque OBC- Odier Bungener Courvoisier. The acquisition of Demachy fits with ABN-AMRO's strategy to expand asset management and investment banking activities in France, the agency said.

The CreditWatch actions will be resolved after meeting with Demachy Worms & Cie's management and ABN-AMRO to review details of the acquisition and the future role of Demachy in ABN-AMRO's operations in France.
